evidence.excerpt: We introduce CompAct-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating working-context compaction through its downstream effect on agent task completion.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As language-model agents are applied to increasingly extended tasks, their working context continuously accumulates interaction history, tool observations, intermediate decisions, and task progress.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our experiments show that working-context compaction remains highly lossy even for frontier models: Claude- and GPT-family models perform strongest overall, yet substantial degradation in downstream task accuracy persists under aggressive compaction.
